welcome: 🛡 Aegis Hello {name}! Aegis is a management and security bot for Telegram groups and channels. Use the buttons below to change the language or read the help.
help: ❓ Help Commands — each also works as a plain word, in English or Persian: /start — main menu (start · شروع) /language — change the language (language · زبان) /help — this help (help · راهنما) /cancel — cancel the current step (cancel · لغو) To use Aegis in this chat you must first join its channels.
help_owner: 👑 Owner /panel — owner panel (panel · پنل): statistics, forced-join channels, broadcasts.
